5cf44f17c1541c4551250e1922541238.pt: Síntese com planadores da vida estática hat siamese vase, tirada do banco de sínteses de Mark Niemiec.

02158b59a8be7779221ad5939eb01178.name: Honey farm synth
02158b59a8be7779221ad5939eb01178.en: Glider syntheses that produce honey farms.
02158b59a8be7779221ad5939eb01178.pt: Sínteses com planadores que produzem honey farms.

35ae70b9f840e3df72dab8fd7f74ff56.name: Integral sign synth
35ae70b9f840e3df72dab8fd7f74ff56.en: Glider syntheses that produce the still life integral sign.
35ae70b9f840e3df72dab8fd7f74ff56.pt: Sínteses com planadores que produzem a vida estática integral sign.

5128b680d679ce8f797dbead7348dcee.name: Jolson synth

5128b680d679ce8f797dbead7348dcee.pt: Sínteses com planadores que constroem o oscilador Jolson.

0756e900a6323cdcf61a243bb2135eef.name: Lightweight spaceship synth
0756e900a6323cdcf61a243bb2135eef.en: Glider collisions that produce lightweight spaceships.
0756e900a6323cdcf61a243bb2135eef.pt: Colisões de planadores que produzem naves leves.

0ed926815d74dfce850c44bfe3d749ee.name: Long boat synth

0ed926815d74dfce850c44bfe3d749ee.pt: Colisões de planadores que constroem long boats.

00880fb7103296881a1390d172a3b66c.name: Long snake synth

00880fb7103296881a1390d172a3b66c.pt: Sínteses com planadores que produzem long snakes.

42a74dbda7a47c7d1a7c25ec9c1c1835.name: Mango synth
42a74dbda7a47c7d1a7c25ec9c1c1835.pt: Colisões de planadores que produzem mangos.

00ba1b755ee145ccc4ebd8dbd0845fa3.name: Mold on 36P22 synth
00ba1b755ee145ccc4ebd8dbd0845fa3.en: Sixteen gliders collide to build the oscillator mold on 36P22.
00ba1b755ee145ccc4ebd8dbd0845fa3.pt: Dezesseis planadores colidem para construir o oscilador mold on 36P22.

0e3a0e1c85a0a553f12b534717f39259.name: Obospark synth
0e3a0e1c85a0a553f12b534717f39259.en: Gliders collide to produce the obo! spark.
0e3a0e1c85a0a553f12b534717f39259.pt: Planadores colidem para produzir a faísca chamada obo!

0e8446b89d6a681cbb386a9f4dfd554e.name: p24 shuttle synthesis
0e8446b89d6a681cbb386a9f4dfd554e.en: Fifteen gliders collide to assemble the p24 shuttle; the recipe is catalogued in Mark D. Niemiec's synthesis collection.
0e8446b89d6a681cbb386a9f4dfd554e.pt: Quinze planadores colidem e montam o shuttle p24; a receita está catalogada na coleção de sínteses de Mark D. Niemiec.

3d0f4a663206bca316c9254187524690.name: p60trafficlighthassler synth
3d0f4a663206bca316c9254187524690.en: Builds the p60 traffic light hassler from 69 gliders.
3d0f4a663206bca316c9254187524690.pt: Constrói o p60 traffic light hassler com 69 planadores.

12691b89c21fc2c400b044d445c69bf1.name: Pentapole synth
12691b89c21fc2c400b044d445c69bf1.en: Nine gliders collide to build the pentapole oscillator.
12691b89c21fc2c400b044d445c69bf1.pt: Nove planadores colidem para construir o oscilador pentapole.

227775f6450c661324cdd992d28afc9e.name: Pincers synth
227775f6450c661324cdd992d28afc9e.en: A glider synthesis of pincers, an oscillator also known as great on-off.
227775f6450c661324cdd992d28afc9e.pt: Síntese com planadores do pincers, oscilador também chamado great on-off.

2e18494ca827d82d7fbddd7d4fdc19c0.name: prepulsarshuttle47 synth
2e18494ca827d82d7fbddd7d4fdc19c0.en: Builds pre-pulsar shuttle 47 out of 52 gliders.
2e18494ca827d82d7fbddd7d4fdc19c0.pt: Constrói o pre-pulsar shuttle 47 com 52 planadores.

1f0e63cbf4584ec4d113c879fc0f2a91.name: Quad synth
1f0e63cbf4584ec4d113c879fc0f2a91.en: Gliders collide to build the oscillator quad.
1f0e63cbf4584ec4d113c879fc0f2a91.pt: Planadores colidem para construir o oscilador quad.

14d2b1a8a52a01d299056bbd3c47b529.name: Roteightor synth
14d2b1a8a52a01d299056bbd3c47b529.en: Gliders collide to build the Roteightor oscillator.
14d2b1a8a52a01d299056bbd3c47b529.pt: Planadores colidem para construir o oscilador Roteightor.

1036d6863361acee831109bea9048baa.name: Ship on quadpole synth
1036d6863361acee831109bea9048baa.en: Glider syntheses of the oscillator ship on quadpole.
1036d6863361acee831109bea9048baa.pt: Sínteses com planadores do oscilador ship on quadpole.

314099ca2951546c907160fe926fe2c8.name: Skewedquad synth
314099ca2951546c907160fe926fe2c8.en: Eight gliders collide to build the skewed quad oscillator.
314099ca2951546c907160fe926fe2c8.pt: Oito planadores colidem para construir o oscilador skewed quad.

018731cb9308b2236cddf964bd416e80.name: Snake synth
018731cb9308b2236cddf964bd416e80.pt: Sínteses com planadores que produzem snakes.

15654ffc6f86fa5291cd6466c65eac0c.name: Stillater synth
15654ffc6f86fa5291cd6466c65eac0c.en: Gliders collide to build the oscillator stillater.
15654ffc6f86fa5291cd6466c65eac0c.pt: Planadores colidem para construir o oscilador stillater.

014d09bf3177cbcea3f617c36ac6b6a3.name: Trans-beacon and dock synth
014d09bf3177cbcea3f617c36ac6b6a3.en: Glider syntheses of the oscillator trans-beacon and dock.
014d09bf3177cbcea3f617c36ac6b6a3.pt: Sínteses com planadores do oscilador trans-beacon and dock.

13b0f287f6813ca0b94219133d8448da.name: Transblockonlonghook synth
13b0f287f6813ca0b94219133d8448da.en: Includes a 4-glider synthesis of trans block on long hook, along with other syntheses by Mark Niemiec.
13b0f287f6813ca0b94219133d8448da.pt: Inclui uma síntese com 4 planadores do trans block on long hook, além de outras sínteses de Mark Niemiec.

394142239921174fe85305978b3029b7.name: Tubwithlongtail synth
394142239921174fe85305978b3029b7.en: Four gliders collide to make the still life tub with long tail.
394142239921174fe85305978b3029b7.pt: Quatro planadores colidem para formar a vida estática tub with long tail.

36b70b70463a9fd9ec52cf982b8584bf.name: Two-glider syntheses
36b70b70463a9fd9ec52cf982b8584bf.en: Every one of the 71 distinct collisions between two gliders, sorted by the objects they create.
36b70b70463a9fd9ec52cf982b8584bf.pt: Todas as 71 colisões distintas entre dois planadores, agrupadas pelo que cada uma produz.

002f0175fca652c0452d4773ad97bff1.name: Verylongbarge synth
002f0175fca652c0452d4773ad97bff1.en: A glider synthesis of the still life long long barge.
002f0175fca652c0452d4773ad97bff1.pt: Síntese com planadores da vida estática long long barge.

5b7cfdd743e8d43cdbc1f65054b545de.name: Whynot synth
5b7cfdd743e8d43cdbc1f65054b545de.en: Gliders collide to build the oscillator Why Not.
5b7cfdd743e8d43cdbc1f65054b545de.pt: Planadores colidem para construir o oscilador Why Not.

c8f0f4bd2699fc480bd414e5a07ab789.name: Blockstacker
c8f0f4bd2699fc480bd414e5a07ab789.en: Keeps laying down blocks in a row that grows without end.
c8f0f4bd2699fc480bd414e5a07ab789.pt: Vai depositando blocos numa fileira que cresce sem fim.

144a70f6796c8ea794ac9504512f8086.name: Gunstar 216
144a70f6796c8ea794ac9504512f8086.en: A version of the gunstar with a true period of 216.
144a70f6796c8ea794ac9504512f8086.pt: Versão do gunstar com período verdadeiro de 216.

e0d7d52511ba958c7bec6db39bf63b1f.name: Mosquito 1
e0d7d52511ba958c7bec6db39bf63b1f.en: Its population grows quadratically over time.
e0d7d52511ba958c7bec6db39bf63b1f.pt: Sua população cresce de forma quadrática com o tempo.

93620b2c3d6cc95322d275493da97902.name: Prime quadruplet calculator
93620b2c3d6cc95322d275493da97902.en: Computes prime quadruplets; it is derived from the twin prime calculator of Dean Hickerson.
93620b2c3d6cc95322d275493da97902.pt: Calcula quádruplas de primos; baseia-se na calculadora de primos gêmeos de Dean Hickerson.

c7c34f4e26c5a44e0efa5e0143400546.name: Tonethirdinfinitgrowth
c7c34f4e26c5a44e0efa5e0143400546.en: Grows without bound, but only like the cube root of time. Glider salvos keep pulling, deleting and duplicating blocks along a diagonal.
c7c34f4e26c5a44e0efa5e0143400546.pt: Cresce sem limite, mas só na proporção da raiz cúbica do tempo. Salvas de planadores puxam, apagam e duplicam blocos ao longo de uma diagonal.

19abed338efb32da5483d7270db29544.name: Bullet heptomino
19abed338efb32da5483d7270db29544.en: What a T-tetromino becomes after one generation.
19abed338efb32da5483d7270db29544.pt: É o que o T-tetromino vira após uma geração.

709c909c513923ba1a86616015bbdd30.name: Coolout Conjecture
709c909c513923ba1a86616015bbdd30.en: A counterexample that disproved the Coolout Conjecture.
709c909c513923ba1a86616015bbdd30.pt: Um contraexemplo que derrubou a Coolout Conjecture.

02207abf564f271d02f788c6f3e7370d.name: Garden of Eden
02207abf564f271d02f788c6f3e7370d.en: A pattern with no possible predecessor: it can exist only at generation 0. This 12x12 example by Nicolay Beluchenko (2006) refines a 13x12 one by Achim Flammenkamp.
02207abf564f271d02f788c6f3e7370d.pt: Configuração sem nenhum predecessor possível: só pode existir na geração 0. Este exemplo 12x12, de Nicolay Beluchenko (2006), aprimora um 13x12 de Achim Flammenkamp.

2eded5d453016089b397bf0705cf9320.name: Grin
2eded5d453016089b397bf0705cf9320.en: A frequent parent of the block; its name alludes to the Cheshire cat.
2eded5d453016089b397bf0705cf9320.pt: Predecessor frequente do bloco; o nome faz alusão ao sorriso do Gato de Cheshire.

2e96305bcad9bd3df900b0041e30aa05.name: Killer toads
2e96305bcad9bd3df900b0041e30aa05.en: Working as a team, two toads can eat other objects; here they swallow an HWSS. An MWSS meets the same fate, but an LWSS is beyond them.
2e96305bcad9bd3df900b0041e30aa05.pt: Trabalhando em equipe, dois sapos (toads) conseguem comer outros objetos; aqui engolem uma nave pesada. Uma nave média tem o mesmo destino, mas uma nave leve eles não conseguem comer.

278be3e7f11fef7dca5b50b87003956e.name: O-pentomino
278be3e7f11fef7dca5b50b87003956e.en: The straight pentomino, five cells in a row; Conway gave it its name. It does turn into a traffic light, but that is not how traffic lights usually arise.
278be3e7f11fef7dca5b50b87003956e.pt: O pentaminó reto, cinco células em fila; o nome foi dado por Conway. Vira um traffic light, mas não é assim que os traffic lights costumam surgir.

4323df0a188952b0feeb19760dec710e.name: Pre-beehive
4323df0a188952b0feeb19760dec710e.en: One step before a beehive: this frequent predecessor turns into one in a single generation.
4323df0a188952b0feeb19760dec710e.pt: Um passo antes da colmeia: este predecessor frequente vira uma colmeia em uma única geração.

05d10fb602dadd7a9a3db0cf6446cc69.name: Seed
05d10fb602dadd7a9a3db0cf6446cc69.en: A cluster of 14 still lifes that turns into a c/7 loafer spaceship when a single glider hits it.
05d10fb602dadd7a9a3db0cf6446cc69.pt: Um conjunto de 14 vidas estáticas que vira uma nave loafer c/7 quando um único planador o atinge.

11336db8939c99a84e3ab07e553338f2.name: T-pentomino
11336db8939c99a84e3ab07e553338f2.en: Named by Conway; a common way for a T-tetromino to appear is from this shape.
11336db8939c99a84e3ab07e553338f2.pt: Batizado por Conway; um T-tetraminó costuma surgir a partir desta forma.

3316df0e2259397c093146d0140163b9.name: Titanic toroidal traveler
3316df0e2259397c093146d0140163b9.en: Shows one repeating piece of a superstring. The front end ends up oscillating with period 16; nobody knows what finally happens to the part that breaks off behind.
3316df0e2259397c093146d0140163b9.pt: Mostra um trecho repetido de uma superstring. A ponta da frente acaba oscilando com período 16; ninguém sabe o que acontece, no fim, com a parte que se solta atrás.

11a73e1cc8c8851bca5d85d2f4853b10.name: V-pentomino
11a73e1cc8c8851bca5d85d2f4853b10.en: Its name comes from Conway; left alone, it becomes a loaf.
11a73e1cc8c8851bca5d85d2f4853b10.pt: O nome vem de Conway; deixado sozinho, vira um loaf.

61d8f3e1c50875b51917ea52d9e47632.name: Z-pentomino
61d8f3e1c50875b51917ea52d9e47632.en: Conway gave this pentomino its name.
61d8f3e1c50875b51917ea52d9e47632.pt: Conway deu nome a este pentaminó.
